coverage.eligibilityUniverse: complete selected-week schedule/deep-dive slate, not weekly-board decision overlay
coverage.screenRule: Screen every FBS-vs-FBS underdog with verified moneyline +300 or longer. FCS-vs-FBS is also researched when a widely posted ML exists, but tracked separately because cross-level independent pricing is less reliable.
coverage.requiredForConsideration: For +1000 or longer, Upset Viability Score >=75 plus a credible QB/offensive path and favorite-volatility case.

candidates.qbThesis: Christopher Vizzina is inexperienced as the full-time starter but has flashed high-end passing output; Clemson retains enough surrounding talent to create a real offensive ceiling rather than requiring a purely fluky upset.
candidates.compressionThesis: Clemson's best path is defensive containment plus enough run-game improvement to avoid a high-possession track meet.
favoriteVolatility: LSU is in Year 1 under Lane Kiffin
new-system uncertainty
LSU roster/QB chemistry still carries Week 1 variance
candidates.explosiveTurnoverPath: Clemson's defensive front and skill talent provide a credible pressure/explosive-play route.
candidates.expertResidual: Mixed but not disqualifying; current public analysis highlights meaningful uncertainty on both sides.
candidates.action: Priority ML research only. Current ATS edge remains below Bet Activation Gate; do not conflate Longshot score with official bet status.

candidates.qbThesis: Tulsa needs stable QB play and enough efficiency to keep OSU from turning its talent infusion into short fields; QB edge is not yet a strength of the case.
candidates.compressionThesis: Home field and rivalry familiarity offer a plausible path to a lower-possession game if Tulsa can stay on schedule.
favoriteVolatility: Eric Morris debut
91 Oklahoma State newcomers
79% of roster new
only five returning players with at least four OSU starts in 2025
candidates.explosiveTurnoverPath: The thesis depends on early-season cohesion mistakes from a massively rebuilt favorite more than on a dominant Tulsa defense.
candidates.expertResidual: CONTRADICTORY: Josh Pate has Oklahoma State -13.5 as a Ramen Noodle Express best bet, citing Morris and the experienced transfer roster.
candidates.action: Priority research candidate; expert contradiction prevents consensus framing.

candidates.qbThesis: Elite-FCS program quality and offensive competence make SDSU materially different from a generic FCS underdog; current reporting highlights experienced QB Chase Mason and a seasoned roster.
candidates.compressionThesis: SDSU's strongest upset path is physical, efficient football that shortens the game and keeps Northwestern from exploiting depth.
favoriteVolatility: Northwestern is not an elite Big Ten roster
early-season system/QB uncertainty remains more relevant than conference label
candidates.explosiveTurnoverPath: SDSU can plausibly create pressure and field-position leverage without needing multiple non-offensive scores.
candidates.expertResidual: Independent public models are unusually supportive for a cross-level dog; current market availability improved to as high as +525.
candidates.action: Priority cross-level research; price improvement strengthens the candidate but does not automatically create a wager.

candidates.qbThesis: John Alan Richter is a fifth-year Toledo quarterback with efficient career spot duty and program familiarity; he gives the Rockets a coherent passing-floor path rather than a pure unknown.
candidates.compressionThesis: The total is only 46.5, giving Toledo a meaningful game-compression route if it avoids early negative script.
favoriteVolatility: Pat Fitzgerald Michigan State debut
Michigan State has missed a bowl four straight seasons
new staff/system variance
candidates.explosiveTurnoverPath: Toledo imported the FCS Defensive Player of the Year and a highly regarded transfer class, creating a plausible pressure/short-field path despite major defensive turnover.
candidates.expertResidual: No newly ingested expert residual is strong enough to promote or veto the research classification.
candidates.action: Live Research only. Production side fair is close to market and does not independently justify a bet; Longshot thesis is structural/price research.

candidates.qbThesis: Arkansas State enters with an experienced offensive core and Texas-transfer QB Trey Owens, giving the dog a legitimate scoring ceiling.
candidates.compressionThesis: The total around 52.5 is not a pure low-total compression game, but Arkansas State can shorten stretches through offensive efficiency and avoid a shootout if it stays ahead of chains.
favoriteVolatility: Memphis is already 1-0 and showed a strong defensive-line floor in Week 0
favorite volatility is therefore lower than the best Lab candidates
candidates.explosiveTurnoverPath: Arkansas State's experienced skill group creates a credible chunk-play path; defensive front turnover remains the primary threat to the upset script.
candidates.expertResidual: Current external Week 1 analysis expects Memphis to win but describes a competitive first half and acknowledges Arkansas State offensive talent.
candidates.action: Live Research only. Current +11.5 also creates roughly two ATS points versus the production -9.5 fair, but official side activation remains separately governed.
